name: KAIST wire bench
full_name: KAIST/Asan guidewire-controller test bench for image-based sim-to-real navigation
group: KAIST School of Electrical Engineering (Dong Eui Chang; Yongjun Cho, Sangbaek Yoo) with Asan Medical Center / University of Ulsan and LN Robotics (Jaesoon Choi)
versions: cho2022_sim (IROS 2022, DDPG+behaviour cloning) -> yoo2025_robust (ICRA 2025, PPO with domain randomisation); same test bench in both
target_anatomy: planar vessel phantom (bifurcating paths) on a bench; coronary-like trees in simulation
n_dof_detail: 2 (translation 0.4 mm steps, rotation 10 deg steps in cho2022)
translation_detail: N.R. (called 'a guidewire controller'; photo shows a compact block with wiring, mechanism not described)
imaging_compat: Overhead camera replaces X-ray; image reduced to vessel and guidewire masks
validation_detail: cho2022: 40 phantom episodes; yoo2025: three tests of 40 runs each on one bench with four paths
key_numbers: cho2022: simulation 100/100, phantom 40/40, 35.06 s vs 63.2 s for the rule-based controller; yoo2025: simulation 86.9 % with vessel randomisation vs 53.7 % without, phantom 93.3 %, 89.2 %, 91.7 % (earlier controllers 83.3 % and 19.2 % in test I) (S7b evidence)
sim_model: SOFA vessel and guidewire simulation, one planar map with four targets (cho2022); randomised vessel trees every episode (yoo2025)
sim2real_detail: yes: both papers train in SOFA and run on the physical bench (cho2022 40/40; yoo2025 93.3 %, 89.2 %, 91.7 %); full read by S7b agent, abstract/figures re-checked here

picture.source: cho2022_sim Fig. 8 (guidewire controller, controller box, camera, phantom), IROS 2022, doi:10.1109/IROS47612.2022.9982168
picture.credit: Cho et al., 2022 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) (2022), Fig. 8. publisher copyright.
picture.edits: native extract (878x878); cropped to the bench; no erasing; not upscaled

sources.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Image-Based Autonomous Guidewire Navigation Trained by Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient with Behavior Cloning for Fast Learning
sources.venue: 2022 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)

sources.title: A Robust Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for Image-Based Autonomous Guidewire Navigation
sources.venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)

notes: Jaesoon Choi is listed with LN Robotics in yoo2025, the maker of the commercial AVIAR (A4 scope); the bench driver may share hardware with AVIAR but the papers do not say so.
